question: The Indian National Science Academy is situated in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian National Science Academy** (INSA) is located in **New Delhi**, the capital city of India.
 
• INSA is a premier scientific organization in India, established in** 1935** to promote **science and its applications** for the benefit of society.
 
• INSA consists of distinguished **scientists and engineers** from various science and technology fields elected as **Fellows of the Academy**.
 
• INSA conducts various activities such as organizing **scientific meetings, conferences, seminars, and workshops, **and awarding fellowships and medals to recognize outstanding contributions to science.
 
• INSA also advises the government on scientific matters and works towards promoting **science education **and the popularization of science in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hyderabad** is home to several prestigious scientific institutions such as the** Indian Institute of Chemical Technology, the Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology**, and the **International Institute of Information Technology.**
 
• **Allahabad** is a historic city in Uttar Pradesh and is home to the** Indian Institute of Information Technology, the Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology,** and the **Indian Institute of Technology.**
 
• **Bangalore, **also known as Bengaluru, is a hub of scientific research and development in India, with institutions such as the** Indian Institute of Science,** the **Indian Space Research Organization**, and the **National Aerospace Laboratories. **
